home.title: Bách Mã Viên - Wild West Horse Riding by the Cổ Cò River
home.description: Bách Mã Viên is an eco-complex and equestrian ranch on the Cổ Cò river between Đà Nẵng and Hội An. One-to-one riding lessons, cowboy experiences, cinematic photo tours and coconut coffee.

about.title: About Us and the Founding Team
about.description: Meet the founders of Bách Mã Viên: the brand story, our Equine Welfare mission and the vision of bringing Wild West riding culture to the Cổ Cò heritage corridor.

services.title: Horse Riding Experiences and Packages
services.description: Four experiences at Bách Mã Viên: Horse Basics Class 450,000 VND, Wild West Cowboy 850,000 VND, Cinematic Photo Tour 1,500,000 VND and Stable Care Workshop 300,000 VND, with a full comparison table.

menu.title: Bách Mã Café Menu and Western Refreshments
menu.description: The Ranch Bar menu: Bách Mã coconut coffee, Cowboy coffee, tea, Wild West Fizz sodas, fresh juices and classics, from 10,000 VND, served by the Cổ Cò river.

safety.title: Horse Riding Safety Guide
safety.description: Safety standards at Bách Mã Viên: riding attire, CE/ASTM certified helmets, one-to-one coaching and the 4 golden steps before you get in the saddle.

booking.title: Book a Horse Riding Experience
booking.description: Reserve your riding experience at Bách Mã Viên: choose a date, time slot, package and extras. Our concierge confirms quickly.
